store.0: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been researching both standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines.

Michael is interested in knowing if your drip coffee makers have adjustable temperature settings or can produce reliably hot coffee. He mentioned that he has had issues with other drip coffee makers that don't get hot enough and has had to microwave his coffee. He wants to ensure that your machines meet his temperature requirements for a satisfying at-home coffee experience.
